idea-plugin.name: winui-svelte
idea-plugin.description:
An optional companion for projects that use winui-svelte, the WinUI 3 controls as Svelte components for native Windows apps; it does nothing in a project that does not depend on it.
  • Icons: a Fluent icon name in a glyph prop, or in any prop typed GlyphInput, shows the icon inside the string, in the documentation popup and in completion
  • Colors: a color in style:color, in style="..." or in a color prop shows a swatch beside it
  • Fonts: the font-family completion lists the installed fonts, each in its own face
  • Resources: a var(--card-background-fill-color-default) completes from the resources WinUI defines, each color with a swatch, and the documentation shows its light and dark value
  • CSS and layout previews: a bar beside a gradient, a curve beside an easing, the WCAG contrast ratio of a text and background color, whether an @media condition holds in an assumed environment, and in the popup the box model, grid tracks, shadow depth, material and what a declaration becomes in WinUI; each can be turned off
  • Pictures: the picture beside the path of every prop, option or object key the library types as a picture (a tray menu item or tray icon, a thumbnail button, an Image source), written as a path, a file: or http(s) URL, new URL(...) or an imported or constant name, also for .ico (best frame, all frame sizes in the popup), .png, .svg, .jpg, .gif, .bmp and .webp; a larger popup with name, pixel size and file size, the light and dark taskbar pictures side by side, a warning for a missing file; remote pictures are fetched in the background (timeout, size cap, no credentials, cache, trusted projects only) unless "Preview remote pictures" is off
  • Convert to CSS: Alt+Enter on a prop that has a CSS counterpart moves it into the <style> block or a style: directive; actions convert a whole file or the selected files and folders, and the class names it writes can be found and renamed
